title: Recent Drafts
description: Lists the five most recently modified post drafts with click-to-edit links.

documentation.purpose: Quick-access list of the five most recently modified drafts. Pairs with `core:simple-editor`'s edit route so writers can resume in one click.

reads.purpose: Five most recent drafts (status: draft, orderby: modified desc, per_page: 5).

navigates: #/posts/{id}/edit — only when the active workspace declares the editor route

states.renders: Stack of five `<Button>` links + modified-date timestamps.

interactions.effect: Real anchor; href resolves via `editTargetHref('post', id, routes)` — workspace editor route when declared, classic `post.php` handoff otherwise.
